content: OpenF1 documents car telemetry and approximate circuit location at about 3.7 Hz. Location lacks lateral placement and uses an arbitrary origin; these samples do not define track distance/curvature without alignment, filtering, and validation. Data availability is unofficial and historical data starts in 2023. Source: https://openf1.org/docs/ . Cross-checked against TUMFTM track database notes that its smoothed centerlines can be off-center: https://github.com/TUMFTM/racetrack-database
